title: Estonian Bible portions, 'Piibel Kõigile' (Bible for everyone), one verse per line
notes: License: 'cc-by-sa' is stated for translation id 'ekkpkp' in the eBible corpus licence table https://github.com/BibleNLP/ebible/blob/2bde52b4c2cfd7056cf4ed07c48969647df79744/metadata/licences.tsv (taken from eBible.org's copyright page, https://ebible.org/ekkpkp/copr.htm). The url pins a fixed commit, so the bytes do not change. 521,929 bytes; eBible corpus format: one verse per line aligned to a fixed versification (empty lines for verses the translation lacks; '<range>' marks merged verses, a few letters each). vs/refcorpus.normalize(..., 'estonian') gives 442,181 characters. Portions only (4,200 non-empty verses).
